source_files: transcript/eng/01/01_001_transcript.txt and transcript/eng/02/02_001_transcript.txt (official transcript.zip; same files on huggingface.co/datasets/SitongGong/EgoExtra)
note: One example = the opening of one expert–trainee session: the transcript lines verbatim (E = remote expert, A = trainee wearing Aria glasses; SRT-style times in raw-video seconds; the English is an LLM translation from Italian, hence the odd wording) plus the multiple-choice VQA sets built from those lines (question, 5 options, correct answer, involved line ids). The raw is cut to the first lines and questions. Clips are cut from the dataset's own 30 s question clips, taken from the third-party HF mirror, because the official server lists no per-video files. The clips have no audio. They end at the question end time, so clip_offset_s is inferred from that (about ±0.1 s). The release readme forbids commercial use.
